title: Page 9
content_zh:
她可是很中意这个女婿的，虽然女儿要她把聘礼退回，她也迟迟还没有行动，暂时静观其变。
又过了一天，情况还是没有任何改变，梁昭颖依旧狠心地不理等待在外的戚无烟。
为了不让自己再继续消沈萎靡下去，梁昭颖开始努力找事情做，想让自己忙碌起来，这样就可以暂时把心上的伤痛忘掉。
她绝不让自己因为这个折磨而爬不起来，她不是这么柔弱的女人，她一定可以坚强地熬过痛苦，她相信只要咬牙再撑一段时间，痛苦终究会过去的。
来到书房，她想借着画画来纾解自己的心情，因为每次只要一开始画画，她就会非常专注到浑然忘我，什么事情都不管，甚至连肚子饿都给忘了。
她来到桌案前，开始挑起画笔，却发现桌上早已摆了一张画到一半的草稿，她这才想起，这本来是她为自己画的嫁衣图稿，但自从楚婉来找过她之后，她便忘了这张图稿的存在，直到现在。
她的心一阵刺痛，眼眶忍不住又泛起泪波，点点泪珠滴到草稿上，晕花了上头的黑色线条，将整张图都毁坏掉了。
本以为她能够振作起来，结果到了这一刻，她才明白自己是多么的脆弱，根本就不堪一击。
她怎么舍得放开他？她对他的爱有多浓烈，现在反噬回来的痛就有多深、多重，已经让她几乎无力招架、心力交瘁了。
这一辈子，她都不想再爱人了，因为她的心早已不在自己身上，现在的她宛如行尸走肉，生不如死，甚至连呼吸都会感觉到心痛呀……
轰隆一一窗外突然响起了雷声，过没多久，滂沱大雨倾盆而下，那猛烈的雨声听得她胆战心惊，就怕戚无烟依旧站在外头，就算下雨了还是不肯离开。
他会这么傻吗？会，他一定会，因为他就是这么执着的人呀！
“无烟！”她冲出书房，再也无法强逼自己继续忍耐下去，现在的她只想马上看到他。
她没有撑伞，淋着雨来到大门前，门仆一见到她出现，既惊讶又担心。“小姐，您怎么没撑伞？”
“是。”
门一开启，果然就见戚无烟依然站在门外，全身早已被雨淋得湿透，脸色因为多天以来的疲累看起来十分憔悴，狼狈得早已不复之前飘然若谪仙的模样。
一些看热闹的民众早已因为下雨而散得差不多，而戚家的仆人在一旁为他撑着伞，非常担心自家二公子，就怕二公子淋了这场雨，免不了要生病了。
听到门开启的声音，戚无烟赶紧抬起头，好不容易终于见到日思夜想的人儿。“昭颖……”
“你……你这个笨蛋！”她再也难耐相思地冲出大门，扑入他的怀里，和他紧紧相拥。
“昭颖，你终于肯见我了……”他欣喜地紧抱着她，就怕这只是因为思念过深而产生的幻觉。

他很累，但只要能见到她，再多的疲累都是值得的，好不容易终于等到她肯出来见他，他绝对不会放过这样的机会，一定要好好把事情搞清楚才行。
她对他的态度一点都不像不爱他，反倒像是被逼着要和他分开一样，他相信自己的感觉，她一定是有苦衷的。
两人拥抱过后，梁昭颖赶紧拉着他进屋。“你别再淋雨了，快点进来。”
梁昭颖将戚无烟带到前厅里，此时英儿也来到前厅，梁昭颖便急着吩咐。“快去拿干布巾来，还有吩咐厨房煮姜汤，快一点！”
“是的，小姐。”英儿立刻前去打点了。
“无烟，你先坐下吧。”看着他脸上憔悴的神色，她的心也跟着难受地拧住，恼他的执着，却也气自己的狠心，非常矛盾。
戚无烟扬起笑容，摸着她同样憔悴的脸颊。“昭颖，你瘦了，是因为我吗？”
“除了你，还有谁能让我如此挣扎痛苦呢？”她无奈地苦笑。
“既然如此，告诉我你之所以想退婚的真正原因，好吗？”他柔声诱哄，希望能哄出她的真心。“我不相信你不爱我，你如果真不爱我，就不会为了我而憔悴，也不会心疼我在外头淋雨的。”
“这……”
“昭颖，我一定要知道真正的原因，要不然你我都会继续痛苦下去的。”
她微咬下唇，眼眶泛红，心酸的泪忍不住滑落，她不能告诉他呀，只要一开了口，或许她所做的一切都会前功尽弃的。
她忍得很痛苦，她一直强逼着自己忍耐，但她也忍得好累好累，几乎快要承受不住这样的压力及痛苦了……
“昭颖……”戚无烟再度将她拥入怀中，一步步软化她最后的挣扎犹豫。“不管出了什么问题，告诉我，我会解决的，只要有我在，我不会让任何问题再将你我分开，我会用尽一切来保护你的。”
“真的？”
“相信我，昭颖，你一定要相信我。”
“呜……无烟……”她疲累的心终于在他的再三柔哄下彻底松懈，只想不顾一切地将所有委屈都告诉他。
她将楚婉来找她，并且拿无戚布庄的安危来威胁她主动退婚的事情全都说了，哭得一把鼻涕、一把眼泪的。
戚无烟除了心疼梁昭颖受到这种威胁之外，也忍不住讶异，没想到楚婉会做出这种事来，这也证明了百鸟朝凤图稿的副本真的是被楚婉拿走，他们并没有盯错人。
“为什么楚婉要逼你向我退婚？这对她有什么好处？”

“这还用问，因为她也喜欢你呀！”她眼眶含泪地瞪了他一眼，没想到他对感情竟迟钝到这种地步。
“呃？”他真的从来没有想过楚婉会喜欢他，感情这种事情是无法勉强的，她怎能因为得不到他，就要昭颖也不能和他成亲？原先他还对楚婉的离去有些许惋惜，到了这一刻，他对她的惋惜也不复存在，只感到失望及无奈。
第9章(2)
他信任楚婉这么多年，没想到最后她却因为得不到他，转而背叛他的信任，甚至还想陷无戚布庄于危机当中。
“无烟，现在怎么办？图稿副本还在楚婉手上，不知道她什么时候会将图稿交给其它人。”
戚无烟温柔地笑着安抚她说：“昭颖，别担心，她的一举一动都已经掌握在我的手中，我不会让她有机会将图稿副本交给别人的。”
有了戚无烟的承诺，梁昭颖终于可以安心地倚偎在他的怀里，不再寝食难安，就怕自己会害他和布庄身败名裂。
她相信他会妥善解决的，不会让任何事再将他们俩给分开，而楚婉也将不会再是可怕的威胁。
拥着心爱的女人，戚无烟欣慰地笑了，原本不安的心终于踏实了，得知她退婚的理由是迫不得已后，他已不再担心害怕，因为他知道，她始终深爱着他，从未变过。
他俯下身，温柔地吻上她的唇，温暖着彼此的唇瓣，好一解这几日来的思念之情，她也欣然地回应他，同样渴望和他亲密交缠，舍不得太快停止这蕴含着无限深情的吻。
但顾虑到随时都可能会有人进到厅里，他只能不舍地率先停下这一吻，微微拉开距离，免得一发不可收拾。
他摸着她嫣红湿润的唇，哑声低喃：“答应我，下次不管再遇到什么问题，都别再随意拿退婚这种事情来吓我，好吗？”
“你还想要有下次？”梁昭颖轻笑出声。“一次就够我们俩受了，我才不要再来一次。”
content_en:
She was very fond of this son-in-law. Although her daughter asked her to return the betrothal gift, she had not yet taken action and was waiting to see what would happen.
Another day passed and the situation still remained unchanged. Liang Zhaoying still cruelly ignored Qi Wuyan who was waiting outside.
In order to prevent herself from continuing to be depressed and depressed, Liang Zhaoying began to work hard to find things to do, trying to keep herself busy, so that she could temporarily forget the pain in her heart.
She will never let herself be unable to get up because of this torture. She is not such a weak woman. She will definitely be able to survive the pain strongly. She believes that as long as she grits her teeth and holds on for a while, the pain will eventually pass.
When she came to the study, she wanted to relieve her mood by painting, because every time she started painting, she would be so focused that she forgot about herself, not caring about anything, even being hungry.
She came to the table and started to pick up the paintbrush, only to find that there was already a half-finished draft on the table. She then remembered that this was originally a draft of the wedding dress she had drawn for herself, but since Chu Wan came to see her, she had forgotten the existence of this draft until now.
Her heart stung, and her eyes couldn't help but burst into tears again. A few tears dripped onto the draft, blurring the black lines on it and destroying the entire picture.
She thought she could cheer up, but at this moment, she realized how fragile she was and how vulnerable she was.
How could she let him go? As strong as her love for him was, the pain that came back was so deep and heavy that she was almost unable to resist and exhausted.
In this life, she doesn't want to love anyone anymore, because her heart is no longer with her. Now she is like a walking zombie. She is worse off than dead. She even feels heartache when she breathes...
Rumble - Thunder suddenly sounded outside the window. Not long after, heavy rain poured down. The sound of the violent rain made her tremble with fear. She was afraid that Qi Wuyan would still stand outside and would not leave even if it rained.
Could he be so stupid? Yes, he will definitely do it, because he is such a persistent person!
"No smoke!" She rushed out of the study, unable to force herself to endure it any longer. Now she just wanted to see him right away.
She came to the door in the rain without an umbrella. The doorman was surprised and worried when he saw her appearance. "Miss, why don't you hold an umbrella?"
"Yes."
As soon as the door opened, they saw Qi Wuyan still standing outside. His whole body had been soaked by the rain, and his face looked very haggard due to the fatigue of the past few days. He was so embarrassed that he no longer looked like an immortal like before.
Some of the spectators had already dispersed due to the rain, while the servants of the Qi family were holding umbrellas for him. They were very worried about their second son, fearing that he would inevitably get sick if he got caught in the rain.
Hearing the sound of the door opening, Qi Wuyan quickly raised his head and finally saw the person he had been thinking about day and night. "Zhaoying..."
"You...you idiot!" She rushed out of the door and threw herself into his arms, hugging him tightly.
"Zhaoying, you are finally willing to see me..." He hugged her tightly with joy, fearing that this was just an illusion caused by missing her too deeply.
He was very tired, but as long as he could see her, no matter how tired he was, it was worth it. After finally waiting for her to come out to see him, he would never let go of such an opportunity, and he had to figure things out.
Her attitude toward him didn't seem like she didn't love him at all, but rather as if she was being forced to separate from him. He believed in his feelings that she must have her own reasons.
After the two hugged, Liang Zhaoying quickly pulled him into the house. "Stop getting wet in the rain and come in quickly."
Liang Zhaoying brought Qi Wuyan to the front hall. At this time, Ying'er also came to the front hall, and Liang Zhaoying hurriedly gave instructions. "Hurry up and get a dry cloth, and tell the kitchen to make ginger soup, hurry up!"
"Yes,Miss. "Ying'er immediately went to take care of it.
"Wu Yan, please sit down first. "Looking at the haggard look on his face, her heart twisted uncomfortably. She was annoyed with his persistence, but also angry with herself for being cruel. It was very contradictory.
Qi Wuyan raised a smile and touched her equally haggard cheek. "Zhaoying, you have lost weight, is it because of me? "
"Who else but you could make me struggle and suffer like this? "She smiled helplessly.
"In that case, tell me the real reason why you want to break off the engagement, okay? " He coaxed softly, hoping to coax out her sincerity. "I don't believe you don't love me. If you really didn't love me, you wouldn't be haggard for me, and you wouldn't feel sorry for me being outside in the rain. "
"This..."
"Zhaoying, I must know the real reason, otherwise you and I will continue to suffer. "
She bit her lower lip slightly, her eyes were red, and the sad tears couldn't help but fall. She couldn't tell him, as soon as she opened her mouth, maybe everything she had done would be in vain.
She endured a lot of pain, and she kept forcing herself to endure it, but she was also so tired and tired that she could hardly bear the pressure and pain...
"Zhaoying..." Qi Wuyan hugged her into his arms again, softening her last struggle and hesitation step by step. "No matter what the problem is, tell me and I will solve it. As long as I am here, I will not let any problem separate you and me again. I will do everything to protect you. "
"real? "
"Believe me, Zhaoying, you must believe me. "
"Wu... Wuyan..." Her tired heart finally relaxed completely under his repeated coaxing, and she just wanted to tell him all her grievances at all costs.
She told all the things about Chu Wan coming to her and threatening her to break off the engagement with the safety of Wuqi Buzhuang, she cried till she had snot and tears.
In addition to feeling sorry for Liang Zhaoying for receiving such a threat, Qi Wuyan could not help but be surprised. He did not expect that Chu Wan would do such a thing. This also proved that the copy of the Hundred Birds Chao Feng artwork was really taken away by Chu Wan, and they were not targeting the wrong person.
"Why does Chu Wan force you to break off the engagement to me? What's in it for her? "
"No need to ask, because she likes you too! " She glared at him with tears in her eyes, not expecting that he was so insensitive to feelings.
"Huh? "He really never thought that Chu Wan would like him. Love cannot be forced. How could she ask Zhaoying not to marry him just because she couldn't get him? At first, he was a little sorry for Chu Wan's departure. At this moment, his regret for her no longer existed, and he only felt disappointed and helpless.
Chapter 9(2)
He had trusted Chu Wan for so many years, but he didn't expect that in the end she would betray his trust because she couldn't get him, and even wanted to put Wuqi Buzhuang into crisis.
“Smoke-free, what should I do now? A copy of the artwork is still in Chu Wan's hands, and she doesn't know when she will give it to others. "
Qi Wuyan smiled softly and comforted her and said, "Zhaoying, don't worry, her every move is already in my hands, and I won't let her have the opportunity to give a copy of the artwork to others. "
With Qi Wuyan's promise, Liang Zhaoying could finally lean into his arms with peace of mind, no longer having trouble sleeping and eating, fearing that she would ruin his and Buzhuang's reputation.
She believed that he would solve it properly and would not let anything separate the two of them again, and Chu Wan would no longer be a terrible threat.
Holding his beloved woman in his arms, Qi Wuyan smiled happily. His originally uneasy heart finally felt at ease. After learning that her reason for breaking off the engagement was out of necessity, he no longer worried or feared, because he knew that she had always loved him deeply and had never changed.
He leaned down and kissed her lips tenderly, warming each other's lips, so as to relieve the longing for the past few days. She responded to him happily, also eager to be intimate with him, and could not bear to stop this kiss that contained infinite affection too soon..
But worrying that someone might enter the hall at any time, he could only reluctantly stop the kiss first and pull away slightly to avoid getting out of hand.
He touched her bright red and moist lips and murmured hoarsely: "Promise me, no matter what problems you encounter next time, you won't scare me with things like breaking off the engagement, okay?"
"Do you still want a next time?" Liang Zhaoying chuckled. "Once was enough for both of us. I don't want it to happen again."
